reviewScope: All four model-visible tools and all eight app-only tools in the release-candidate contract. The API catalog is documentation-only and cannot execute account API requests. Number Intelligence requires explicit confirmation for each billable lookup, Voice Monitor is read-only, and the internal billing app is not publicly federated.

justification.readOnlyHint: Returns endpoint metadata and does not call the selected Telnyx API endpoint.
justification.openWorldHint: Only reads the server's private API catalog.
justification.destructiveHint: Cannot create, update, send, purchase, or delete anything.

justification.readOnlyHint: Lists or searches endpoint metadata without calling an account API.
justification.openWorldHint: Only reads the server's private API catalog.
justification.destructiveHint: Cannot create, update, send, purchase, or delete anything.

justification.readOnlyHint: Opens the Number Intelligence interface and does not itself perform a lookup.
justification.openWorldHint: Opening the bundled interface does not change public or third-party state.
justification.destructiveHint: Opening the bundled interface cannot delete or overwrite data.

justification.readOnlyHint: Returns the Voice Monitor interface; its initial dashboard population is limited to bounded option and active-call reads.
justification.openWorldHint: Opening and populating the bundled interface does not change public or third-party state.
justification.destructiveHint: The opener and initial reads cannot alter calls or recordings.

justification.readOnlyHint: Each invocation performs a billable Telnyx Number Lookup and can change the account balance, so it is not classified as read-only even though it does not mutate phone-number resources.
justification.openWorldHint: The tool accepts an arbitrary phone number and queries Telnyx and carrier intelligence outside the local MCP server, so it is open-world even though it does not publish or message anyone.
justification.destructiveHint: The lookup charge is an irreversible transaction. The server requires confirm_billable_lookup=true and the UI sends it only after the user presses the labelled billable control.

justification.readOnlyHint: Each unique accepted number causes a billable Telnyx Number Lookup and can change the account balance, so the batch is not read-only.
justification.openWorldHint: The batch accepts arbitrary phone numbers and queries Telnyx and carrier intelligence outside the local MCP server, so it is open-world even though it sends no communications.
justification.destructiveHint: Lookup charges cannot be undone. The server requires confirm_billable_lookup=true, executes sequentially, deduplicates inputs, and caps each batch at 25 accepted numbers.

justification.readOnlyHint: Builds the dashboard from bounded option discovery and active-call GET requests and cannot issue Call Control commands.
justification.openWorldHint: Reads only the authenticated user's private Telnyx account and does not contact call participants or publish data.
justification.destructiveHint: Cannot start, answer, transfer, hang up, record, or otherwise alter a call.

justification.readOnlyHint: Lists bounded connection, application, and number options using GET requests only.
justification.openWorldHint: Reads private Telnyx account metadata and does not reach recipients or public systems.
justification.destructiveHint: Cannot create, update, delete, or activate any Telnyx resource.

justification.readOnlyHint: Lists active calls through bounded GET requests and exposes no call-control action.
justification.openWorldHint: Reads private account state without contacting participants or changing public state.
justification.destructiveHint: Cannot answer, transfer, bridge, record, or terminate calls.

justification.readOnlyHint: Retrieves existing call events with bounded filters and does not enqueue work or change the call.
justification.openWorldHint: Reads private Telnyx call-event data only and does not publish or send anything.
justification.destructiveHint: Cannot modify events, calls, recordings, or account configuration.

justification.readOnlyHint: Uses the read-only GET call-status endpoint and exposes no Call Control command.
justification.openWorldHint: Reads a private account-scoped call record and does not contact the call or any external party.
justification.destructiveHint: Cannot alter or terminate the selected call.

justification.readOnlyHint: Searches existing recordings with GET requests only; sensitive URLs, transcripts, and metadata are redacted from output.
justification.openWorldHint: Reads private Telnyx recording metadata and does not publish, share, or transmit a recording.
justification.destructiveHint: Cannot create, start, stop, delete, or download a recording.
